name: Foxy Jump
camera_perspective: 2D orthographic side view with smooth horizontal follow camera
art_style: Colorful, cute cartoon forest with an original orange fox, glowing gems and simple wooden or grassy platforms
mechanics: Fox moves left/right with Rigidbody2D physics
Touch finish flag to win once all 5 gems are collected
One short forest level with platforms
Fox flips horizontally on direction change
Animation states: idle, run, jump, fall, land
Gem sparkle, jump and landing dust effects
Parallax background and smooth camera follow
controls: Keyboard A/D/arrows and Space as secondary controls for testing
level_structure: One short forest level with a start area, several ground and floating platforms, 5 gems placed along the route, a finish flag at the end, and a fall-reset safety zone. The flag wins only after all 5 gems are collected, and shows a hint otherwise.
ui_requirements: In-game Left, Right and Jump touch buttons

required_assets.prompt: Original cute orange fox character sprite sheet, side view, transparent background, cartoon style. Frames for idle, run cycle, jump stretch, fall pose and landing, consistent size and alignment.
Colorful cartoon forest background with layered sky, distant trees and foreground foliage, suitable for parallax scrolling, no characters.
Glowing cartoon gem collectible, cyan faceted crystal with soft glow, transparent background.
Cartoon forest platform tile, grassy top over brown earth or wood, transparent background, tileable horizontally.

requirements.original_instruction: Build a small, polished 2D Android game called "Foxy Jump".
requirements.implementation: Create a small polished game titled Foxy Jump targeting Android.

requirements.original_instruction: Create a real Unity 2D project, not 3D.
requirements.implementation: Use a Unity 2D project with 2D physics, sprites and an orthographic camera; no 3D assets.

requirements.original_instruction: One short forest level with platforms.
requirements.implementation: Single Game scene with a short forest level and platforms.

requirements.original_instruction: A cute orange fox that moves left/right and jumps.
requirements.implementation: Player fox with Rigidbody2D movement left and right and a grounded jump.

requirements.original_instruction: Collect 5 glowing gems
requirements.implementation: Five gem trigger colliders increment the counter on pickup and are removed.

requirements.original_instruction: reach the finish flag to win
requirements.implementation: Finish flag trigger shows the victory screen when all 5 gems are collected.

requirements.original_instruction: Generate an original transparent-background fox sprite.
requirements.implementation: Generate a transparent fox sprite sheet with an image model.

requirements.original_instruction: Generate a colorful cartoon forest background.
requirements.implementation: Generate a layered cartoon forest background image.

requirements.original_instruction: Generate gem and platform sprites.
requirements.implementation: Generate gem and platform sprites with transparent backgrounds.

requirements.original_instruction: Import the generated images into Unity as actual Sprite assets.
requirements.implementation: Set the texture type to Sprite (2D and UI) with proper PPU and slicing, and use them in scene renderers.

requirements.original_instruction: Simple touch controls: Left, Right, Jump.
requirements.implementation: Three on-screen touch buttons wired to the player controller.

requirements.original_instruction: No enemies, complicated mechanics, or extra levels.
requirements.implementation: Exclude enemies, extra mechanics and additional levels.

requirements.original_instruction: Idle: fox gently breathes and blinks.
requirements.implementation: Idle animation with breathing and blinking frames or a procedural scale tweak, played when grounded and still.

requirements.original_instruction: Run: animated legs and bouncing body while moving.
requirements.implementation: Run frame animation with a body bounce, played while moving on the ground.

requirements.original_instruction: Jump: fox stretches upward during takeoff.
requirements.implementation: Jump state with vertical stretch on takeoff.

requirements.original_instruction: Fall: fox changes pose while descending.
requirements.implementation: Fall state used when vertical velocity is below 0 and not grounded, with a distinct pose.

requirements.original_instruction: Land: brief squash-and-stretch effect.
requirements.implementation: Land state on ground contact after falling, with a brief squash and recovery.

requirements.original_instruction: Flip the fox horizontally when changing direction.
requirements.implementation: Flip the sprite (flipX or scale.x) based on input direction.

requirements.original_instruction: Use sprite-sheet frame animations where available, or lightweight Unity Animator/procedural animations if necessary.
requirements.implementation: Use sliced sprite-sheet frames in an Animator controller; fall back to procedural transform animation if frames are poor, and report which was used.

requirements.original_instruction: Animations must actually play during gameplay, not just exist as unused files.
requirements.implementation: Animator or procedural state is driven by runtime physics and input, and the active state is exposed for probes.

requirements.original_instruction: Smooth camera follow.
requirements.implementation: Camera follows the player with SmoothDamp and level bounds.

requirements.original_instruction: Parallax forest background.
requirements.implementation: Background layers scroll at different fractions of the camera movement.

requirements.original_instruction: Gem collection sparkle effect.
requirements.implementation: Particle sparkle burst on gem pickup.

requirements.original_instruction: Simple jump and landing effects.
requirements.implementation: Dust particles on takeoff and landing.

requirements.original_instruction: Landscape orientation.
requirements.implementation: Set the default orientation to Landscape Left/Right only.

requirements.original_instruction: Responsive on-screen movement and jump buttons.
requirements.implementation: Canvas with a scaler and anchored large buttons that respond to multitouch with no lag and allow holding.

requirements.original_instruction: Gem counter (0/5).
requirements.implementation: HUD text showing collected/5 that updates on pickup.

requirements.original_instruction: Main menu, victory screen, and Restart button.
requirements.implementation: MainMenu scene with Play, a Victory panel, and a Restart button that reloads the level and resets the counter.

requirements.original_instruction: Proper 2D colliders and Rigidbody2D physics.
requirements.implementation: Player Rigidbody2D and Collider2D, platform BoxCollider2D, trigger colliders for gems and flag.

requirements.original_instruction: Verify movement, jumping, landing, gem collection, and victory.
requirements.implementation: Runtime probes cover movement, jump, landing, gem pickup and victory.

requirements.original_instruction: Verify idle, run, jump, fall, and land animations trigger correctly.
requirements.implementation: Runtime probes record the animation state during idle, run, jump, fall and land.

requirements.original_instruction: Keep the project lightweight and suitable for Android.
requirements.implementation: Use small compressed textures, few objects and simple particles, with the IL2CPP/ARM64 or default Android settings.

requirements.original_instruction: Automatically repair detected errors within the configured limits.
requirements.implementation: The supervisor repair loop retries within the retry and $10 budget caps.

requirements.original_instruction: Build a working Android APK
requirements.implementation: Build the APK in the pipeline and verify that it exists and is valid.

requirements.original_instruction: deliver it through Telegram
requirements.implementation: Send the verified APK to Telegram in the delivery stage.

requirements.original_instruction: Report clearly if image generation or animation creation is unavailable; do not claim static sprites are animated.
requirements.implementation: The final report states which assets were generated and whether the animation is frame-based or procedural; no false claims.

requirements.original_instruction: Keep the game simple and inexpensive to generate.
requirements.implementation: Limit to 4 image assets and one level, within the job cap.

tasks.description: Finalize the design, level layout and animation state rules.
Generate the fox sprite sheet, forest background, gem and platform images.
Set up the Unity 2D project, import sprites as Sprite assets, and configure the Android landscape and lightweight settings.
Implement the player physics, colliders, touch and keyboard controls, jump and flip.
Implement the animation system (idle, run, jump, fall, land) driven by runtime state, with procedural fallback.
Build the level, gems, finish flag and win logic.
Implement the camera follow, parallax, sparkle, and jump and landing effects.
Build the main menu, HUD gem counter, victory screen and Restart.
Write runtime probes for movement, jump, landing, gems, victory and animation states; review the visuals.
Run the repair loop, build the APK, verify it, and deliver it via Telegram.

assumptions: Victory requires all 5 gems plus the flag
Keyboard controls are included for testing alongside touch
Fox animation is sliced sprite-sheet frames if the generated sheet is consistent; otherwise procedural animation on the sprite
Falling off the level resets the player to the start
Audio is not requested and is omitted
limitations: Generated sprite-sheet frames may be inconsistent; procedural animation is the fallback and will be reported honestly
Work stays within the $10 cap and the configured retry limits
Telegram delivery depends on pipeline credentials
